hub.notes: Low-battery redesign: buttons stay playable while warning (red flashes), bow out cleanly at 3.1V with a charge prompt on the hub and app. Fixes connected buttons vanishing from the app's lists until a hub reboot.

node.notes: Low-battery redesign: readable red warnings (1s red / 5s normal while lit, red breathing otherwise), still fully playable; at 3.1V the button disconnects itself and breathes red until charged. Power-off protection unchanged.
